summary: 10.0.38.10 Enterprise Light Theme Audit & Desktop Feature Parity Release
highlights: 1. GSTR-1 Subpanel Strict Display Isolation: Enforced CSS display: none !important vs display: block !important across Table 4 (B2B), Table 7 (B2CS), Table 9B (CDNR), Table 12 (HSN), and Table 13 (Docs) eliminating stale table overlap.
2. GSTR-1 CDNR Credit/Debit Note Mapping: Integrated OperationsService.getCreditNotes() and getDebitNotes() to populate Table 9B with real data and fallback parity.

3. Smart Operations PO Navigation Parity: Fixed '+ Create PO' button in AutomationCenterController to route to view-purchase-creation with pre-populated item code and quantity instead of blank screen.
4. Reports & BI Exception Elimination: Added TableUiEnhancer.enhance(target) alias resolving TypeError in ReportsController and enabling dynamic auto-adjusting headers.
5. Bank Statement Two-Step Delete Parity: Enhanced Delete Confirmation modal with interactive validation, Enter key support, click feedback, and light theme contrast fixes.
6. Comprehensive Light Theme Hardening: Resolved all 17 defects from user audit across Dashboard Reminders, My Profile, User Permission Matrix, Quotation Editor, Filter Toolbars, and KPI ribbons.
